question.text: Section VIII of the SEBI-prescribed PPM template deals with 'Determination of the Net Asset Value of the Units'. This section is SPECIFICALLY applicable to:

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9.5 Box 9.1 explicitly labels Section VIII — Determination of the Net Asset Value of the Units — as 'pertaining to Category III AIFs'. This is because Cat III publishes NAV (monthly for open-ended, quarterly for close-ended) and needs a formal valuation policy disclosure. The Trap: Options A and B are Cat I/II, which do not have daily/quarterly NAV publication in the same sense. Option D (Angel Funds) is exempted from many PPM rules altogether. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests the same Cat III-specific section. XIX-D (Cat I/II Manager) typically tests the 6-monthly valuation extendable to yearly with 75% investor consent. Manager's Pro-Tip: In Section VIII, bake in your Level-1/Level-2/Level-3 valuation hierarchy (mark-to-market for listed longs/shorts, model-based for OTC swaps, and policy-driven for illiquid side-pocket) — aligning with IPEV and SEBI valuation-committee expectations.
